name: Article 1 – § 1 – after point 18 – 71
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards the extension of its scope to downstream goods and anti-circumvention measures
part_text: 2. The power to adopt delegated acts referred to in Article 2(10) and (11), Article 2a (3), Article 6(7), Article 18(3), Article 20(5a) and (6), Article 27(6) and shall be conferred on the Commission for a period of five years from [date of entry into force of this amending Regulation]. The Commission shall draw up a report in respect of the delegation of power not later than nine months before the end of the five-year period. The delegation of power shall be tacitly extended for further periods of an identical duration, unless the European Parliament or the Council opposes such extension not later than three months before the end of each period.
